pages.title: Drive Access Center — Northwest Custom Apparel
pages.mainText: Drive Access Center What appears in File Explorer for each person, versus what they can actually change or read. Read-only reference — nothing here edits the server. ← Dashboard Admin · File access NCA-FS01 drive map Mapped from the NCA Drive Maps group policy, Active Directory group membership and audited folder ACLs. Default production login — Search access By person By drive Print Server: — Policy: — Verified: — Loading the access snapshot… Mapped — the drive letter appears automatically. Modify — create, edit, move, delete. Read only — open and copy. Full control — file-administrator accounts. A person can have folder access without the drive letter being mapped — Erik reaches K, R and T through Y: or a UNC path even though they do not auto-map for him. To update this page, re-verify the GPO, recursive AD group membership and folder ACLs, then edit lib/drive-access-data.json (bump verifiedAt) and deploy.
